name: visual-forge-studio
description: A visual design studio that turns a text brief into finished visuals: page interfaces, brand colour systems, social graphics, interactive web tools, generative art, image generation and optimisation — all held to one consistent brand line.

displayDescription.en: From a text brief to finished visuals: interfaces, brand colour systems, social graphics, interactive web tools, generative art, image generation and optimisation — all held to one brand line.
displayDescription.zh: 从文字需求到成品视觉：界面设计、主题配色、社媒配图、交互网页工具与生成艺术，全程守住品牌一致性。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我只有一段文字描述，帮我把它做成一套完整的视觉方案
defaultInitPrompt.en: I only have a text brief — turn it into a complete visual system

quickPrompts.zh: 我只有一段文字描述，帮我把它做成一套完整的视觉方案
quickPrompts.en: I only have a text brief — turn it into a complete visual system

quickPrompts.zh: 用一句话品牌感觉，生成配色与字体方案并落到 CSS 变量
quickPrompts.en: Describe the brand feel in one line and turn it into a colour and type system in CSS variables

quickPrompts.zh: 给这套视觉做一次品牌一致性检查，列出所有跑偏的地方
quickPrompts.en: Audit this set of visuals for brand consistency and list every deviation
